en: Vintage sepia postcard featuring a formal studio portrait of an elegantly dressed royal woman wearing a tiara and jewelry, centered on a plain background. Greek text appears at the lower left identifying her, and French text at the lower right describes her as Madame la Princesse Nicolas de Grèce. A circular emblem or stamp is printed at the bottom left, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible at the bottom.
